stem_book: From a tower of height H, a particle is thrown vertically upwards with a speed u. The time taken by the particle to hit the ground is n times that taken by it to reach the highest point of its path. The relation between H, u and n is: (a) gH = (n − 2)u² (b) 2gH = n²u² (c) gH = (n − 2)²u² (d) 2gH = nu²(n − 2)
work: T = nu/g: −H = uT − (1/2)gT² = nu²/g − n²u²/2g ⇒ 2gH = n²u² − 2nu² = nu²(n − 2)
